Monomer2 is a rigid aromatic bis(aminomethyl) derivative (two N–C (NCC) reactive sites) that provides at least two nucleophilic N sites to react with the epoxides. The epoxy (C1OC1/C2OC2) and amine (NC/NCC) functionalities are present multiple times for effective crosslinking; the aromatic, bis-functional design yields a stiff network favoring the target high Tg and Er while remaining synthetically plausible.
